hero.title: CosmoRemote
hero.subtitle: Test what your agent just built, from your phone
hero.description: CosmoRemote runs on your Mac, with your project on it; the phone is the remote. You pick a project and a simulator, the Mac builds, installs and launches it, and the screen streams to you. Tap through the change, read the build log, hit your local API, then send the next prompt knowing what actually broke.
hero.note: iPhone, iPad and Android are all live. Pick your store below.

features.description: Everything below happens on your Mac. Your phone just shows the result.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.description: No inflated metrics, no fake store links, and no invented reviews.

questions.question: Do I need a Mac?
questions.answer: Yes. The bridge runs on your Mac and your project lives there. The phone shows the screen, the build log and your sessions.

questions.question: Is CosmoRemote available?
questions.answer: Yes. iPhone and iPad on the App Store, Android on Google Play. The bridge runs on macOS.

questions.question: How does pairing work?
questions.answer: Run cosmoremote start in your project, scan the QR with the app, and the phone talks to the Mac directly on your network.

questions.question: What does Tests actually do?
questions.answer: It is a live preview you drive by hand: the Mac builds and launches the app, you see the screen and tap through it. It is not a test runner, there are no assertions or pass and fail. On the newest iOS simulators the stream is a capture a few seconds behind.

questions.question: Can I switch between Claude Code and Codex?
questions.answer: Yes. You choose the CLI per session before sending commands.

questions.question: What is included in Free?
questions.answer: Install, QR pairing, streaming, history, offline access, 1 Mac, 1 session at a time, unlimited messages, and Tests on your home network. Pro adds Tests away from home, multiple Macs, parallel sessions and push notifications.
